title: Marco Pierre White's BBQ Lamb Chops & Salmon with Ketchup Vinaigrette
originalTitle: Marco Pierre White's BBQ Lamb Chops & Salmon with Ketchup Vinaigrette
ingredients: 6 lamb rib cutlets or loin chops + 2 fresh salmon steaks/fillets
2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil + 2 sprigs fresh rosemary (used as a basting brush)
Marco's Ketchup Vinaigrette: 3 tbsp tomato ketchup, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp balsamic or red wine vinegar, 4 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, 1 clove garlic (crushed)
1 tsp Dijon mustard, pinch of sugar, flaky sea salt & cracked black pepper
Freshly chopped chives or flat-leaf parsley
instructions: Whisk together tomato ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, balsamic vinegar, Dijon mustard, crushed garlic, and olive oil until emulsified into Marco Pierre White's signature tangy ketchup vinaigrette.
Rub the lamb chops and salmon fillets with olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper (never oil the grill grates directly; oil the protein).
Grill or cast-iron sear the lamb chops 3–4 minutes per side and the salmon 4 minutes per side, brushing with fresh rosemary sprigs.
Rest the hot lamb chops and salmon directly in a shallow platter of the ketchup vinaigrette so the warm meat juices mingle with the dressing.
